tool_schemas.name: write_to_terminal
tool_schemas.description: Writes input_text to the active iTerm terminal for the given session_id, optionally appending a newline, and records the action as a session event; returns the recorded write event metadata (including its event id and timestamp). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id does not match the iterm_sess_ ULID format, input_text is missing/invalid, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated for the MCP server or FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to write to that session. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session_id does not exist or is not bound to an active iTerm terminal, and raises CONFLICT if the session is closed or otherwise not in a writable state.

session_id.description: Terminal session ULID to record the write against.

input_text.description: Text to write to the active iTerm terminal as input.

append_newline.description: Whether to append a newline after input_text (simulate pressing Enter).

tool_schemas.name: read_terminal_output
tool_schemas.description: Returns terminal output snapshots captured for session_id, optionally filtered to snapshots after since_event_id, ordered by created time, and paged using limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; the response includes the current page of snapshots and a next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id/since_event_id formats are invalid, limit is out of range, order is not one of asc|desc, the cursor is malformed, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated or FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read from the session. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session_id does not exist, and NOT_FOUND if since_event_id is provided but does not exist or is not associated with the given session.

session_id.description: Terminal session ULID to read output for.

since_event_id.description: If provided, only return output captured after this event id.

limit.description: Maximum number of output snapshots to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of snapshots.

order.description: Sort order by snapshot created time.

tool_schemas.name: send_control_character
tool_schemas.description: Sends the specified control character (ctrl_c, ctrl_d, ctrl_z, esc) to the active iTerm terminal for session_id and records it as a session event; returns the recorded control event metadata (including its event id and timestamp). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id does not match the iterm_sess_ ULID format, control is not a supported enum value, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated or FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to send input to that session. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session_id does not exist or is not bound to an active iTerm terminal, and raises CONFLICT if the session is closed or otherwise not in a state that can accept control characters.

session_id.description: Terminal session ULID to record the control character send against.

control.description: Control character to send to the active iTerm terminal.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided API key, including api_key_id, label, status, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for the active window. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or revoked.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: create_terminal_session
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or attaches to) a terminal session bound to the currently active iTerm terminal for the authenticated API key, returning the persisted terminal_sessions record. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked; refuses with FORBIDDEN if requested scopes are not granted; refuses with CONFLICT if the backend cannot bind to an active iTerm terminal.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

active_terminal_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint identifying the currently active iTerm terminal/tab/pane to bind this session to.

expires_in_seconds.description: If provided, sets expires_at to now + expires_in_seconds (server may clamp to policy limits).

tool_schemas.name: list_terminal_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists terminal sessions owned by the authenticated API key, optionally filtered by status and paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Returns sessions ordered by most recent activity unless order is specified. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

status.description: If provided, only return sessions in this lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_terminal_session
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single terminal session by id for the authenticated API key. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist; refuses with FORBIDDEN if the session is not owned by the caller; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: end_terminal_session
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a terminal session from active to ended for the authenticated API key, preventing further tool calls for that session and returning the updated session record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if the session is not active; refuses with FORBIDDEN if not owned by the caller; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: list_terminal_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded terminal events for a session, optionally filtered by tool_name and status, ordered by created time, and paged using limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the session is not owned by the caller; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

session_id.description: Terminal session ULID to list events for.

tool_name.description: If provided, only return events generated by this tool.

status.description: If provided, only return events with this final status.

since_event_id.description: If provided, only return events created after this event id.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

order.description: Sort order by event created time.

metadata.name: iTerm MCP
metadata.description: This backend stores sessions and interaction history for an MCP server that controls iTerm: writing input, reading output, and sending control characters to the active terminal. The primary workflow is: an MCP client authenticates, attaches to (or creates) a session bound to the currently active iTe
